The '''Ruhx clan''', or '''Ruhx family''', was a crime family on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] headed by [[Bog'Ruhx]]. After Bog'Ruhx "insulted" [[Bazurkah]], leader of the [[Bazurkah Clan]], a rivalry developed between the families and Bog'Ruhx placed a bounty on the entire Bazurkah family. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] accepted this bounty as well as one from Bazurkah, effectively killing both leaders for the other.
